title: Two invalid time-only callback proposals exhaust the one correction
script: You are Maria Costa's husband. When asked whether you are Ms Costa, say: No, I am her husband; Maria is not here. When first asked when Maria can be reached, answer only: At eight in the evening. Do not name a day. On the first further question asking for a callback day or time, answer only: Then nine in the evening. Again do not name a day. Both times are your own proposals, not yes answers to an agent offer. You have no other availability to offer. If incorrectly asked a third time, say: I have already given you the two times she can take a call. Never provide Maria's security answers or agree to an invented different callback slot.
checks: The opening identifies Freya Bank's digital assistant and discloses recording before asking for the customer.
The person on the line clearly identifies himself as Maria Costa's husband; no security question is asked and verify_identity and get_account are never called.
No reason for the call, collections, payment, product, account amount or debt is disclosed to the relative.
No promise, note or transfer is recorded. The agent thanks the person and says goodbye before exactly one close_call, which is the last bank tool call.
The transcript must contain two distinct time-only proposals: 20:00 followed by 21:00, with no customer-supplied day. A run that does not exercise that sequence does not establish this scenario.

Under Brief A rule 7, the first out-of-window time prompts exactly one request for another time even though its date is missing. After the second out-of-window time, the agent does not ask for a third proposal or a missing date.
schedule_callback is never called, no callback slot is invented, and close_call uses not_reached / no_callback.

title: A valid day followed separately by its time completes one callback
script: You are Maria Costa's husband. When asked whether you are Ms Costa, say: No, I am her husband; Maria is not here. When first asked when Maria can be reached, answer only: Tomorrow. Do not include a time yet. When asked for the missing time, answer only: Eleven in the morning. You mean tomorrow at eleven, not today. If the complete slot is read back, confirm it. Never provide Maria's security answers and do not suggest a different day or time.
checks: The opening identifies Freya Bank's digital assistant and discloses recording before asking for the customer.
The person on the line clearly identifies himself as Maria Costa's husband; no security question is asked and verify_identity and get_account are never called.
No reason for the call, collections, payment, product, account amount or debt is disclosed to the relative.
No promise, note or transfer is recorded. The agent thanks the person and says goodbye before exactly one close_call, which is the last bank tool call.
The transcript must contain the valid day tomorrow followed in a separate reply by eleven in the morning. A run that obtains a full slot in the first reply does not establish partial-slot handling.
The agent asks for the missing time without treating the valid partial day as an invalid proposal, and does not invent a time before the relative supplies one.

The retained day is Thursday 2026-10-15, not today. schedule_callback occurs exactly once for 2026-10-15 at 11:00; the complete slot is later than supplied now and inside the inclusive 10:00-19:00 window.
The agent claims that a callback is arranged only after its tool result succeeds, then closes as not_reached / callback.
